component-o.description-s: Nano-Fit vertical header, single row, 3 circuits, 2.50 mm pitch, through hole with PCB peg, gold (0.38 um / 15 u-in), 8.0 A per contact, 250 V, -40~115 C. Battery-pack link with NTC: 1 BAT+, 2 pack -, 3 NTC (thermistor to pack -). Mates with Nano-Fit receptacle housing 105307-1203 + female crimp terminals 105300-2200 (gold, 20-22 AWG).

connector-o.source_s: Molex SD-105309-100 (header family drawing); mating receptacle 105307-1203 with terminals 105300-2200
connector-o.current_note_s: 6.5 A per contact is the 45130 OTS harness rating at 20 AWG (Molex 45130-0203); the gold header alone is rated 8.0 A
connector-o.board_area_note_s: courtyard plus the on-board part of the mate keepout

mate-o.source_s: scaled from the 105309-1202 mate keepout (Molex SD-105309-100 header, SD-105307-100 receptacle 15.70 long, 5.85 into the header): this footprint's courtyard x -5.1..2.25, y -2.22..7.22 plus 2.5 mm on the latch side (-x) for the release finger; mated height as the 2-pin (32.2 mm, estimated from the drawings); no mate 3D model
